note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records (Jan 2025 - Nov 2025) from Mundra/Ahmedabad ICD to Iran, Morocco and Saudi Arabia. HS codes actually shipped are 12024210 (groundnuts, shelled), 12074090 (sesame seeds) and 12023010 (groundnuts, in shell) - the declared set 090812/120740/130232 does not match the observed records: 090812 (nutmeg) and 130232 (guar gum) do not appear in any visible shipment; 120740 appears only as 12074090. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground - company stays in the base with the HS code corrected to the factual 12024210 / 12074090 / 12023010 and verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Note the declared industry 'food & FMCG' is consistent with the observed agri-commodity trade (peanuts, sesame). Domestic supply side is unverified (null), not negative - tools were blocked, so 'unknown' rather than 'none_found'. Revenue and export volume figures: not public on the free view, recorded as null.
